intro: A batched decoder must hide future tokens and padding. These are separate constraints that need to hold at the same time.
task: Return a boolean allowed-attention mask for batches of variable sequence lengths with a fixed padded length.
requirements: max_length is a positive integer excluding booleans. lengths is a nonempty vector of integer values from zero through max_length.
Return a boolean NumPy array with shape (batch, max_length, max_length), with query rows and key columns.
True means allowed: both positions are below that batch item’s length and key_position <= query_position. Padded query rows are entirely False.
Do not modify inputs. Raise ValueError for the invalid shapes, ranges, or non-finite numeric inputs described above. Numerical checks use moderate finite values unless stated otherwise.

examples.name: Short padded sequence
examples.output:
[[[True, False, False],
  [True, True, False],
  [False, False, False]]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

examples.name: Empty sequence is fully masked
examples.output:
[[[False, False], [False, False]]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

examples.name: Mixed batch lengths
examples.output:
[[[True, False], [False, False]],
 [[True, False], [True, True]]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

hints.title: Choose the representation
hints.body: Build a lower-triangular position comparison, then intersect query-valid and key-valid comparisons.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: This function returns True for allowed attention; some library APIs use the opposite convention.

explanation: A causal mask stops a decoder position from reading future keys. A padding mask removes positions that do not represent real tokens in shorter sequences.
Combining the constraints also masks padded queries here. Such rows contain no allowed keys and must be handled deliberately by a downstream softmax implementation.
Inspect a sequence of length two in a padded length of four. Explain why masking only key columns leaves meaningless query rows, and why a mask convention must be documented before connecting APIs.
